integrity: The exact matrix identities and finite low-degree calculations are reproducible with included standard-library Python code; the infinitely many remaining degrees are proved by a separate Legendre bound. Self-review is not independent certification.
scientific_limitations: Only single-degree sampling at the twenty regular dodecahedral vertices on S^2. Parity-incompatible data are inaccessible. No higher-dimensional, stability-optimality, or simultaneous-degree result is asserted. The full text of a plausible 1958 predecessor was inaccessible, so its coverage is a residual originality risk. Independent validation has not been conducted.
title: All-degree harmonic sampling spectrum of the regular dodecahedron
